methodologyNotes: Covers standalone handheld graphing calculators sold at a published US MSRP. Excludes non-graphing scientific/financial calculators, phone/tablet graphing apps, and software-only tools (e.g. Desmos). Price is typical US MSRP in USD. displayType is an enum: monochrome-lcd, color-lcd, color-backlit-lcd, or e-ink. displayResolutionPx is the native pixel grid as width x height. screenSizeIn is the diagonal display size in inches. casSupport is a boolean: true if a Computer Algebra System is built in. pythonSupport is a boolean: true if an on-device Python interpreter ships in firmware. rechargeableBattery is a boolean: true for a built-in rechargeable pack, false for user-replaceable cells (AA/AAA). flashStorageMb is user-accessible flash/archive memory in MB; null if not disclosed. ramKb is operating RAM in KB; null if not disclosed. examApproval lists the standardized exams the model is permitted on (SAT, ACT, AP, PSAT, IB), or 'none' if barred (typically CAS models); reflects current US test policy. connectivity is the data port enum: usb-c, mini-usb, usb-b, or none. weightGrams is device weight in grams including batteries.
